description: Asks, on a writable copy, which DELETE spellings Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) accepts over Dm and One, in sequence, each followed by RecordsAffected, DBEngine.Errors and the count of Dm rows: with and without *, a qualified star, an alias, a missing column list, a join with either table as target and with DISTINCTROW, TOP, LIMIT and ORDER BY, a subquery returning one and several rows, an EXISTS condition, a never-true WHERE, an unknown table and column, and no WHERE. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
